title: 2.5 Seeds
description: Seeds — every fact from the textbook.

questions.question: What are the three parts of a seed?
options: A long protein fiber extending from centrioles
Seed embryo, cotyledon/endosperm and seed coat
Unsaturated ones are solid at room temperature
The study of theoretical biological principles
questions.correctAnswer: Seed embryo, cotyledon/endosperm and seed coat

questions.question: What is the seed additionally covered by in angiosperms?
Why are angiosperm seeds called covered seeds?
options: They communicate better with healthy cells
They are additionally covered by the fruit
The type of food available in an ecosystem
questions.correctAnswer: They are additionally covered by the fruit

questions.question: What are gymnosperm seeds called because they have nothing except their own seed coat?
What does the seed embryo consist of?
options: Amino group, carboxyl group, and R group
Arranged in the form of one or two rings
Oxygen intake and carbon dioxide removal

questions.question: What does the radicle develop into?
What does the plumule develop into?
What is the function of cotyledon and endosperm?
options: It is cheap, well known by local people, and environment friendly as it breaks down naturally within about two days
They are food storing tissues essential for the seed embryo until it forms leaf and starts manufacturing its own food
Microbial preparations containing living cells of microorganisms that mobilize nutrients from unusable to usable form

questions.question: How many cotyledons does a dicot seed have?
How many cotyledons does a monocot seed have?

options: Pyramid of water, air, and soil

questions.question: How are monocot cotyledons described in terms of food storage?
options: They store large amounts of food
Very thin and lack food materials
questions.correctAnswer: Very thin and lack food materials

questions.question: What is the status of endosperm in dicot seeds?
What is the status of endosperm in monocot seeds?

All proteins, both structural and functional
It prevents water from dissolving substances
It is replaced by adventitious fibrous roots

It is replaced by adventitious roots
